The image shows soybean seeds held in a hand with prominent pink-to-purple blotchy discoloration on the seed coats. Some seeds are heavily stained purple/dark purple, others appear normal yellow/tan. The staining appears near the hilum area and extends outward.

Top candidates:
- **Purple_Seed_Stain** — pink to purple spots ranging from specks to large blotches on seed coats, extending from hilum
- **Cercospora** — also Cercospora kikuchii, pink to purple seed coat discoloration
- **Bean_Pod_Mottle_virus** — smoky/mottled seed coats

Let me view reference images for the top candidates.

Excellent match — the Purple_Seed_Stain reference top-right panel shows nearly identical seeds held in a hand with the same pink-to-purple blotchy staining. Cercospora reference shows leaf symptoms only, not matching.

Let me view a few more references to meet the minimum requirement.

Bean_Pod_Mottle shows black seeds and mottled leaves — no purple staining. Phomopsis shows pod/stem pycnidia damage. Downy_mildew shows leaf symptoms. None match the test image.

**Initial prediction: Purple_Seed_Stain** — the seeds held in hand show classic pink-to-purple blotchy staining on seed coats, perfectly matching the reference collage.

Now reading the Attractor Guide.

Purple_Seed_Stain is listed as over-predicted. Alternatives: Bean_Pod_Mottle_virus, Frogeye_leaf_spot, Phomopsis. I've already checked Bean_Pod_Mottle and Phomopsis — neither matches. Let me check Frogeye_leaf_spot quickly.

Frogeye_leaf_spot reference shows gray circular lesions on leaves with reddish-brown borders — no purple seed staining. The top-left panel shows a single dark/green seed, nothing like the multiple seeds with purple staining in the test image.

**All alternatives ruled out.** The test image unambiguously shows multiple soybean seeds with pink-to-purple blotchy staining on seed coats — a textbook Purple_Seed_Stain presentation. The reference collage for Purple_Seed_Stain (top-right panel) is virtually identical to the test image.
